verdict.rationale: The changelog says external AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor connect to Missive's official MCP server and act 'with the permissions you choose', which implies per-agent permission scoping. This is a single thin claim. Nothing documents how scopes work for REST API tokens or what granularity exists. Missing for 10: documented per-token scope or permission model for API keys, granularity of MCP permissions (read vs. write, per resource), credential revocation or rotation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
